Name: Yandere Elliott Dialogue Expansion (English Translation)
Author: Kxgarashii
Description:
[size=4]Credit to KatherineC4 for the creation of this lovely, lovely mod!
[/size]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12393?tab=description]Original Mod[/url] [/size][/color][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12393?tab=description][size=3][color=#f4f4f4]by KatherineC4[/color][/size]
[/url][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14270]Yandere Portrait Mod[/url] ﻿by NinTheCactus69[/b][/size]

[size=2]Let me know about any errors, typos, repetitiveness, etc and I'll fix it ASAP![/size]

[size=2]This mod includes: [/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Pre-marriage dialogue[/size]
[*][size=2]Post-marriage dialogue[/size]
[*][size=2]Festival dialogue[/size]
[*][size=2]Mail [i](Prerequisites at the bottom of the page)[/i][/size]
[*][size=2]Reactions from the townspeople[/size]
[*][size=2]Events! [i](Guide on how to get them at the bottom of the page. Divorce events are deactivated by default)[/i][/size]
[*][size=2]Small Schedule changes [i](Must be turned on in config)[/i][/size]
[/list]
[left][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b]
[/size][size=2]SVE compatibility has been added.
[/size]Android has not been tested.
Other dialogue mods may overwrite this one.

[b][size=4]Warnings!
[/size][/b][i][size=1]*There are behaviors depicted in this mod that may be uncomfortable or triggering. Download at your own risk. [/size][/i]
[b]Unhealthy relationships and codependency
Obsessive behavior
Stalking
Emotional manipulation and gaslighting
Threats of violence
Suicide threats and allusions to suicide[/b][/left][size=4][b]
Installation
[/b][/size][1] ﻿Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Event Repeater
[2] ﻿(Optional) Install Unique Courtship Response CORE and Custom NPC Exclusions
[3] ﻿Put [CP] Yandere Elliott Expansion into Stardew Valley\mods folder.
[4] ﻿Regarding the configuration (please open config.json or use Generic Mod Config Menu to modify it)

[size=4][b]Configuration
[/b][/size]
[b]ChangeSchedule[/b] - Makes changes to Elliott's schedule.[i] It is off by default[/i] but can be switched on at any time.

[b]CertainEvents[/b] - Dictates whether or not "Black" events will occur. [i]It is on by default[/i].
[size=2]Note: These events restrict normal gameplay, so it's recommended to turn it off if you don't want that to happen[/size]

[b]DivorceEvents[/b] - Dictates whether or not the divorce event will occur. [i]It is off by default.
[/i][size=2]WARNING:  The divorce event includes themes of [b]suicide[/b]. This event is off by default, but you can turn it on in the config. For immersion purposes, download CustomNPCExclusions[/size]

[left][b]﻿[/b][size=4][b]How To Trigger Events[/b]
[/size]
[size=3][u]Pre-marriage events[/u][/size]
[size=2]Note: The following events [b]cannot [/b]be activated after marriage[/size]

[b][1 Heart] [/b]
[spoiler]Go to the mountain after 10 pm. This event cannot be triggered after receiving 8 heart mail[/spoiler]

[b][3 Heart] [/b]
[spoiler]Go to the beach after the Moonlight Jellies festival on Summer 28[/spoiler]

[b][5 Heart] [/b]
[spoiler]Go to Elliott's house between noon and 5 pm[/spoiler]

[b][7 Heart] [/b]
[spoiler]Before triggering the original 10 hearts event, leave the farmhouse on a sunny day[/spoiler]

[b][9 Heart] [/b]
[spoiler]After triggering the 5-heart event, enter the farmhouse after 8 pm on a rainy day[/spoiler]

[u][size=3]Post-marriage events
[/size][/u][size=2]Note: You can only pick one route. Route 1 (Black) can be turned off in the config.json.[/size][/left]
[b][Route 1] - Black[/b]
[size=1]Note: This event can be turned off in the config
[i][size=1](Also, If you use the harem mod, you mustn't be married to any of the other original bachelors)[/size][/i][/size]
[spoiler]Part 1: Give a bouquet to every original bachelor, do not break up with any of the bachelors or view the group ten-heart event (if you use the rabbit's foot, the event is considered not triggered), reach 11 Hearts with Elliott, then enter the bar.[i][size=1]
[/size][/i]Part 2: Get to 13 hearts with Elliott and enter the farm
Part 3: Get 14 hearts with Elliott and enter the farmhouse after 8 am[/spoiler]

[b][Route 2] - White[/b]
[spoiler]Part 1: If you don't trigger the 11-Heart Black event, after reaching 13 hearts with Elliott you will receive a letter in the mail. Read the letter
Part 2: Go to the beach after 7 pm[/spoiler]

[size=3][u]Divorce Events
[/u][/size][b]WARNING: These events feature suicidal themes
[/b][size=1]Note: These events are off by default. You can set "DivorceEvents" to true in the config[/size]
[spoiler]Part 1: Divorce Elliott. The next day, leave the farmhouse and the event will occur
Part 2: You'll later receive a letter from Elliott. After reading this letter, go to the beach[/spoiler]

[size=4][b]How To Trigger Mail [/b][/size]
[size=1]Note: The letters are set up in this manner simply to prevent you from receiving too many at once. As long as you view Elliott's heart events, you will receive these letters[/size]
[spoiler][1 Heart] 
No prerequisite

[2 Heart] 
Trigger the original 2-heart event

[3 Heart]
Trigger the original 4-heart event

[4 Heart]
Trigger the 1-heart event

[5 Heart]
Trigger the 5-heart event, but not the 7-heart or original 10-heart event

[6 Heart]
Trigger the original 8-heart event

[7-heart]
Trigger 3-heart event

[8 heart]
Trigger 9-heart event

[Seasonal Letters]
If you have at least 1 heart with Elliott, you will receive one letter on a certain date for each season

[Love letter 1]
Give a bouquet to any original male bachelor. Can only be triggered once

[Love Letter 2]
Give a bouquet to every male bachelor

[size=1](The following letters [/size][size=1]cannot be triggered after receiving the 8-heart letter or getting married to Elliott)[/size]
[Special letter 1]
If you give a bouquet to Elliott but don't marry him, you'll receive this letter at 10 hearts

[Special Letter 2]
If you are not married to Elliott, and your friendship level is higher than 4 hearts, you will receive this letter on the day of the Flower Dance.[/spoiler]
